target_scope: V01中间白色含泪坐姿，可见正侧前角度；不覆盖全群
exact_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a flat 2D research reconstruction of the single white crying creature in the attached reference crop. Preserve exactly its visible silhouette and pose: a very broad round white head-body with no neck, two round upper ears with open curved joins, three rounded foot lobes along the bottom, two short raised arms with inward curving ends beside its cheeks. Preserve the two small dark upright tearful eyes, each with white shine spots, wide eye spacing, the tiny curled w-shaped mouth between them, small distress strokes above the mouth, and the two tiny pale cyan tear patches outside the eyes above the hands. Keep the irregular charcoal contour thickness, white fill and cyan accents, the low face position, and the asymmetric visible curves. White background, full figure centered with margin. No added eyes, nose, clothing, props, lettering, logos, shadows, gradients, fur, 3D rendering, or extra characters. The attached crop is the sole identity and pose reference; reproduce only that visible front three-quarter sitting version, do not invent a back view.
